thread:
Ilya Novak: Quick sync — we're doing an int4+quant-smoke bring-up next week. Need a promptset that exercises tokenization edgecases, deid leakage, and long-prefix KV-cache churn. Who can own a curated slice?
Carla Mendes: I can assemble. Plan: 65% real, 35% synthetic; de-dup vs samplebank and 3% adversarial paraphrases.
Owen Li: Add a compact golden set (120 examples) for fast regression checks. I'll reserve labeler capacity.
Carla Mendes: Will include holdouts: deid (emails, ssn-like), code blocks with inline diffs, and citation/RAG prompts. Also repeat-prefix templates to trigger kv-cache eviction.
Ilya Novak: Please tag each item with provenance: `origin`, `synth_seed`, `deid_flag`, and `kvcache_repeat`. Eval pipeline should be able to filter.
Carla Mendes: Yep. I'll output sample manifests and small TSV of potential tokenizer mismatches using int4-tokenizer-v2.
Owen Li: Label rubric: PII leak, masked-but-inferred, hallucination (fabricated facts), benign. Keep gold scoring pass/fail + note.
labelops-bot: created ticket INF-5011 for "int4 promptset curation + golden 120" - https://tracker/INF-5011
Ilya Novak: When running smoke, collect per-holdout metrics: LLR distribution, hallucination-F1 (prioritize deid), citation-precision, and token-split rate. Attach logs to INF-5011.
Carla Mendes: Draft PR incoming with manifests and a small sample (400 synth seed -> 200 candidate -> 120 gold). Ping me for QA review.
Owen Li: I'll open the label queue and assign reviewers. Targeting dry-run by Thursday.
Ilya Novak: Great — keep synth generator deterministic and include CSV provenance. If any holdout drops halluc-F1 >10 pts vs baseline, we halt the canary.
